src.label: Bahrain Customs Affairs — personal pets (importing live pets)

head: Pets are restricted: arrange the veterinary quarantine check before you land.
lines: Bahrain Customs treats a pet travelling with you as a restricted item under the control of the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs' Veterinary Quarantine.
The traveller or importer must coordinate in advance with the regulator and tell it the date and time of arrival, to avoid delay.

If you do not coordinate, Customs contacts the regulator itself and you must wait at the airport until its representative arrives and finishes the procedures. Afterwards a simplified customs declaration is prepared. The page lists no vaccination, microchip or permit conditions.
